To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the sanctions against Russia are a tool of the United States to maintain its global leadership and to weaken Russia, and that Germany has to suffer the most.
sanctions against Russia are not a goal but a means of pressure on Russia, and that Germany is the main beneficiary of this policy.

the German government, the Bundestag and the European Commission have been trying to convince the public that the anti-Russian sanctions are a response to the actions of the Kremlin, and that they are aimed at protecting the European security architecture.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of the impact of sanctions on Russian-German relations and their consequences for the economy, politics and society of both countries.
the analysis of the Russian and German mass media in the context of the current sanctions policy.

the following questions: what is the attitude of the Russian and German public to the anti-Russian sanctions? What are the reasons for the imposition of sanctions by the West against Russia? What are the consequences of the sanctions for the Russian and German economy? What are the prospects for the development of Russian-German relations in the near future?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the sanctions against Russia are not only the cause of the deterioration of relations between the two states, but also a serious blow to the economy of both countries.
the sanctions are a double-edged weapon, which, in addition to the negative consequences for the economy, can have a significant impact on the domestic political situation.
the sanctions against Russia are a manifestation of a new type of war in the 21st century, the main purpose of which is the destruction of the economic and political system of the Russian Federation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Russian and German mass media are not only the main sources of information about the sanctions imposed on the Russian Federation, but also the main channels of communication of the political elite with ordinary citizens.
the sanctions against Russia are a political and economic game, in which the main players are Germany and the United States, while Russia is only an excuse.

the German media, in general, are critical towards sanctions and the policy of their implementation, while the Russian media is trying to present the situation in a positive light, emphasizing that the sanctions are ineffective and do not affect the Russian economy, but only harm the German economy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the German and Russian media have similar views on the problem of sanctions, but they are presented differently.
the sanctions policy of Germany is aimed at the weakening of the Russian Federation and is not in the interests of the German economy, which is dependent on Russian energy resources.

the sanctions policy of the West against Russia is a manifestation of the desire to limit the influence of the country on the international arena and to prevent the development of the Russian economy.
